findings.message: A screen-reader data table + live region expose the data non-visually (accessibleTable is on).
Semiotic's default tick and axis-label fonts are 12px, meeting Chartability's 9pt/12px floor.
findings.fix: If a theme or override lowers --semiotic-tick-font-size below 12px, raise it back for low-vision audiences.

findings.message: No flashing detected statically. Confirm no element flashes more than 3×/sec.
findings.fix: Manual check — most static charts pass trivially.

findings.heuristic: Interaction modality only has one input type
findings.message: Built-in keyboard navigation (arrows/Home/End/PageUp-Down/Enter) mirrors mouse hover.
The chart takes a single tab stop and navigates data with arrow keys — the recommended pattern for dense charts (no per-datum tab stops to wade through).
Chart is interactive and has descriptive text. Confirm that text explains how to interact (keyboard + pointer).
findings.fix: State the interaction model in summary, e.g. "Use arrow keys to move between points."

findings.message: Keyboard handlers fire only while the chart has focus, so they don't hijack page/app screen-reader shortcuts.

findings.heuristic: Keyboard focus indicator missing, obscured, or low contrast
findings.message: A shape-adaptive focus ring (var(--semiotic-focus)) marks the focused element.
findings.fix: Ensure --semiotic-focus keeps ≥ 3:1 contrast against your background.

findings.message: Provided: title, description, summary.

findings.heuristic: No explanation for purpose or for how to read
findings.message: A description/summary is available to explain purpose and how to read the chart.
Description/summary reads at ~grade 4 (≤ 9).
WCAG 2.1 / Section 508 conformance can't be settled from config alone.
findings.fix: Run an automated checker (axe) on the rendered output and test with real assistive tech.

findings.message: Whether interactive elements expose correct roles/names is a render-time, screen-reader question.
findings.fix: Verify with a screen reader that buttons read as buttons, the chart as an image/group, etc.

findings.message: Charts render on canvas with an SVG overlay and render to SVG in SSR, so access isn't tied to one rendering path.
findings.fix: Still test across NVDA+Firefox, JAWS+Chrome, and VoiceOver+Safari — AT support varies.

findings.message: A human-readable data table is provided (accessibleTable).
The data table is read-only — not downloadable, sortable, or filterable.
findings.fix: Wrap the chart in a ChartContainer and enable its data-download action (opt-in, so deployments can withhold it where export isn't allowed).

findings.heuristic: State is not easy to share and reproduce
findings.message: Chart state serializes via toConfig/toURL/copyConfig.
findings.fix: Expose it to users via the ChartContainer copyConfig action or a shareable URL.

findings.heuristic: Information cannot be navigated according to narrative or structure
findings.message: Keyboard navigation steps through points and switches series/groups.
findings.fix: For deeper structure (axis → series → datum), enable ChartContainer's navigable option.

findings.message: 3 data points — a reasonable density for non-visual consumption.

findings.heuristic: Data in text is not human-readable
findings.message: Data includes large numbers (≥ 100,000) and no value/tick formatter — screen readers will read every digit (e.g. "six hundred fifty thousand…").
findings.fix: Pass valueFormat / yFormat (e.g. a compact formatter so 6,500,000 reads as "6.5M"); the formatter flows to ticks, tooltips, and the data table.

findings.heuristic: Visually apparent features and relationships are not described
findings.message: A summary is present. Confirm it describes trends, extrema, clusters, and outliers — not just what the chart is.
findings.fix: Cover the L2/L3 content blind readers value most: direction of trend, peak/trough, notable outliers.

findings.message: A "Skip to data table" link lets screen-reader users bypass point-by-point navigation.
Styling flows through CSS custom properties and honors forced-colors mode, so user/user-agent style changes cascade in.
findings.fix: Avoid hardcoding colors via frameProps style fns that bypass theme variables.

findings.message: prefers-reduced-motion is auto-detected; transitions fast-forward and looping animation stops.

findings.heuristic: Zoom and reflow are not supported
findings.message: Fixed width/height — verify the chart survives browser zoom and reflow without clipping or loss of function.
findings.fix: Use responsiveWidth/responsiveHeight so the chart reflows to its container.

accessibility.reference: Chartability (POUR-CAF) — https://chartability.github.io/POUR-CAF/. Not a pass/fail cert; pair with manual screen-reader testing (NVDA+Firefox, JAWS+Chrome, VoiceOver+Safari).

render.ariaLabel: Each floating bar adds or subtracts a revision. Its endpoint is the running estimate, in jobs; bar length is the change between drafts, not another month's employment.
